title: Execution reservation
description: What execution_reserve returns: what is held for one execution and, once the run is approved, the grant the provider redeems. A paid run without a standing approval is awaiting_approval, with no grant, until its provider approves it.

logical_intent_id.description: Links several executions of the same intended work, e.g. after failover.

plan_id.description: Plan the call is admitted under.

resource.description: What is held: budget (the unit price, against your budgets) or free.

funding.description: How the run was approved: free (a free plan's run, approved by the network) or approval (by the provider: once, by a standing approval, or automatically).

approval_id.description: The standing approval the run was reserved under, or that its approval created.

unit.description: Which unit price the run is charged at: plan, or overage (a subscription's overage_price, when the provider approved it as overage).

state.description: awaiting_approval (a paid run waiting for its provider; no grant yet), held (approved, grant usable), redeemed, reconciliation_required, captured, released or expired.

approval_deadline.description: While awaiting_approval: when the run expires unless the provider approved it. Timestamp, ISO 8601 with time zone.

answer_by.description: While awaiting_approval: when the run is released unless the provider has answered. Timestamp, ISO 8601 with time zone.

payment.description: The provider's request to be paid before it approves the run, when it made one.

decision_reason.description: Why a waiting run ended unapproved: the provider's reason, PROVIDER_NO_ANSWER, or the deadline.

grant_expires_at.description: When the grant expires: 60 seconds after reservation, or 10 minutes after the provider approved a waiting run. Timestamp, ISO 8601 with time zone.

amount_atoms.description: Integer amount in atoms (1 USD = 1000000 atoms) as a decimal string, e.g. "400000".

commission_atoms.description: The network's commission on the run, held from the provider's commission wallet, in atoms as a decimal string, e.g. "12000".

budget_period_ids.description: Budget periods the amount is held against.

admission_id.description: Set once the provider redeemed the grant.

execution_grant.description: The execution grant (a signed JWT); send it with the capability call. Present once the run is held; never while it is awaiting_approval.
